structure_and_depth.basis: The complete report answers the original scene-dependent selection question through a coherent chain: separate chemistry/electrolyte/form/pack objects; retain the conditions and missing denominators of representative observations; explain chemistry and system mechanisms; derive explicitly hypothetical cost and use sensitivities; distinguish maturity evidence from targets; and finish with four conditional use-case choices and reversal conditions. The matrix does not merge Gotion cell density, CATL pack density, BYD charging and low-temperature announcements into an invented battery. The absence of comparable Wh/L or private procurement prices is stated at the affected comparisons. Charging energy and upstream power, calendar/cycle life and usable-window throughput, pack safety and cell-abuse results are connected to actual decisions rather than repeated source summaries. The cost section distinguishes market aggregates from cost layers and a normalized scenario. Yield, utilization, lithium/nickel input shocks, usable energy, pack mass and downtime each have stated assumptions and different uses; these are not presented as BatPaC outputs or measured products. BatPaC original sections 9.5.2 and 9.6 support the dependency on utilization, materials/cell yields and fixed/variable costs. The maturity matrix distinguishes delivered JAC vehicles, NIO trial service, BMW vehicle testing and planned Toyota/QS production; the original QS 2026-10-21 announcement confirms an Eagle Line demonstration and a targeted 2028 start for the planned 100 MWh line, not achieved output. The ending connects these limitations to procurement and investment evidence thresholds. The complete manuscript develops the previously reviewed outline into substantial mechanisms, arithmetic and case synthesis. Production history and the retained first draft were inspected: repeated same-content saves are not counted as distinct substantive stages; the actual v1-to-current changes clarify usable-window cycles and the scope of stoichiometric material sensitivity. No missing mechanism or compressed inference material to this assigned perspective requires correction.
